handedness: MediaPipe handedness labels on unmirrored frames
normalization: Input x, y in normalized image coordinates [0, 1]; z as reported by MediaPipe (pose: relative to hip midpoint, hands: relative to the wrist). origin = midpoint(left_shoulder, right_shoulder) in (x, y); scale = euclidean distance between the shoulders in (x, y); x' = (x - origin_x) / scale, y' = (y - origin_y) / scale, z' = z / scale
